# Issue: Rewrite README quickstart and execute it in CI
Type: task | Scope: README.md, docs/getting-started.md, scripts/quickstart_check.sh (new), .github/workflows/ci.yml | Priority: high

## Definition of Done
The quickstart is rewritten against a fresh clone with every command verified verbatim: duplicate skill-install step removed, the .arm/ worktree vs .armature/ state-dir distinction stated once and matching getting-started.md, README installation covers go install and released binaries, and a CI job extracts and runs the quickstart commands in a scratch repo so future drift fails the build.
